summary_md:
**Bessi S ([@LLMpsycho](https://x.com/LLMpsycho/status/2114994940128436462))** describes **BAMA** ("Build Any Mac App"), 21 agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that recreate a Mac app you like as native SwiftUI.

The workflow has the agent screenshot each screen, write user stories, then implement one story per commit — running tests and light/dark snapshot checks first.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - daveebbelaar/bama: BAMA: Build Any Mac App. Agent skills to research, clone, design, build, optimize, and test native macOS apps with Swift and SwiftUI.

relevance: A well-structured example of decomposing a large build into research → stories → test-gated commits via skills.
